## Overview

Chat models are not finished after instruction tuning. In the last stage they learn from **comparisons**: given two responses to the same prompt, which one is better? This is how models learn to be more helpful and to avoid bad answers. Two common methods are RLHF (reinforcement learning from human feedback) and **DPO (Direct Preference Optimization)**.

| Stage | Assignment |
|---|---|
| 1. Pre-training → base model | 14 |
| 2. Instruction tuning → follows an instruction | 15 |
| 3. **Preference tuning** → prefers better responses | **16 (this one)** |

You will let your instruction-tuned model write several stories for each topic, use an automatic judge to pick a better and a worse story, and train the model with DPO to prefer the better ones. Then you will check what improved and what it cost.
